uncited: **Ray-Volume Intersection:** Determine the entry ($t_{min}$) and exit ($t_{max}$) distances of the ray with the volume bounding box.
**Step Size Calculation:** Determine the step size along the ray.
Sample the volume texture at the current ray position to get the scalar value $v$.
Sample the transfer function using $v$ to get color $c$ and opacity $\alpha$.
If pre-computed gradients are used, sample the gradient texture at the current position to get $\nabla v$.
Advance the ray position by the step size.
If $A_{acc} \geq 1$ or the ray has exited the volume, terminate the loop.
*   **Gradient Pre-computation:** Trade-off between memory usage and computational cost.
